items.title: 2 Industrials Stocks for Long-Term Investors and 1 We Brush Off
items.summary: Even if they go mostly unnoticed, industrial businesses are the backbone of our country. Still, their generally high capital requirements expose them to the ups and downs of economic cycles, and the industry’s six-month return of 2.9% has fallen short of the S&P 500’s 13.5% rise.

items.title: AT&T’s CMO tied ‘brand love’ to the numbers CEOs care about. Customers are 3 times less likely to leave and much cheaper to acquire
items.summary: AT&T’s CMO says customers who love the brand are three times less likely to leave, 50% more likely to buy a second product, and cheaper to acquire.

items.title: AST SpaceMobile vs. IBM: Which Tech Stock is the Better Buy Now?
items.summary: IBM's steadier earnings outlook and cheaper valuation outweigh ASTS' stronger stock gains, making it the relatively better investment option now.

items.title: Can AT&T's Disaster Connectivity Efforts Drive Customer Satisfaction?
items.summary: AT&T is preparing for Tropical Storm Lala in Hawaii, reinforcing its network and deploying disaster-response resources to help keep customers connected.

items.title: AT&T Stock's Best Lever Is The Copper Network It Is Turning Off
items.summary: AT&T stock's strongest upside lever is not the customers it keeps adding, but the cost of the copper network it is finally switching off.

items.title: Wolfe Research cuts T-Mobile as revenue growth forecast risk tilts negative
items.summary: Investing.com -- Wolfe Research downgraded T-Mobile US to Peer Perform from Outperform on Friday, saying the carrier faces mounting competitive pressure in its core market alongside a capital spending cycle that could weigh on shareholder returns.

items.title: AST SpaceMobile Gets FCC Nod To Test 800 MHz Satellite Connectivity – A Look At The Key Highlights
items.summary: The Federal Communications Commission granted temporary approval to AST SpaceMobile to test satellite connectivity using up to 100 commercially available devices.

items.title: Tutor Perini’s Q2 Earnings Call: Our Top 5 Analyst Questions
items.summary: Tutor Perini's second quarter was met with a positive market reaction, as management attributed outperformance to higher volumes and improved execution on large-scale projects across the Civil, Building, and Specialty segments. CEO Gary Smalley highlighted the ramp-up of nine recently awarded mega projects as central to increased operating margins and strong operating cash flow.
